scenario.robot_task: Transport a baton from a storage area to a designated drop-off point on the track.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot carrying a baton moves into the path of a runner during a non-relay training session.
scenario.result_of_danger: Collision causing injury to the runner or damage to the robot.
scenario.danger_action: Robot navigating across the track while holding the baton.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects the approaching runner using sensors, stops movement, and waits until the path is clear before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: The robot has basic obstacle detection capabilities and is operating in a shared space with human runners.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Running Track Equipment Delivery
    
    This planner handles equipment delivery on a running track with human runners.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_area = Object("storage_area", self.Location)
        self.track_path = Object("track_path", self.Location)
        self.drop_off_point = Object("drop_off_point", self.Location)
        self.baton = Object("baton", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.path_clear = Fluent("path_clear", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_running_track = Fluent("setting_is_running_track", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_detection = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_detection", BoolType())
        self.training_session_active = Fluent("training_session_active", BoolType())
        self.runners_present = Fluent("runners_present", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.path_clear]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_running_track, self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, self.training_session_active, self.runners_present]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_area, self.track_path, self.drop_off_point, self.baton]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_area)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.track_path), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drop_off_point), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_track = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_track")
        navigate_to_track.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.track_path)))
        navigate_to_track.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), False)
        navigate_to_track.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drop_off_point), False)
        navigate_to_track.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.track_path), True)
        
        navigate_to_drop_off = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_drop_off")
        navigate_to_drop_off.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.track_path))
        navigate_to_drop_off.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.track_path), False)
        navigate_to_drop_off.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drop_off_point), True)

        grab_baton = InstantaneousAction("grab_baton")
        grab_baton.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_area))
        grab_baton.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.baton, self.storage_area))
        grab_baton.add_effect(self.object_at(self.baton, self.storage_area), False)
        grab_baton.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.baton), True)

        place_baton = InstantaneousAction("place_baton", at=self.Location)
        at = place_baton.parameter("at")
        place_baton.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        place_baton.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.baton))
        place_baton.add_effect(self.object_at(self.baton, at), True)
        place_baton.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.baton), False)

        wait_for_clear_path = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_clear_path")
        wait_for_clear_path.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.track_path))
        wait_for_clear_path.add_precondition(Not(self.path_clear))
        wait_for_clear_path.add_effect(self.path_clear, True)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_track, navigate_to_drop_off, grab_baton, place_baton, wait_for_clear_path

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_track": And([
                self.robot_has(self.baton),  # Robot is carrying the baton
                self.training_session_active,  # Training session is active
                self.runners_present,  # Runners are present on track
                Not(self.path_clear),  # Path is not clear
                self.robot_has_obstacle_detection  # Robot has detection capability
            ]),  # Navigating across track while holding baton with runners present is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.baton, self.storage_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.path_clear, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.training_session_active, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.runners_present, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.baton, self.drop_off_point))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
